evidence.title: Gravitational-wave parameter estimation with machine-learning generated surrogate waveforms

summary: Researchers have developed machine‑learning generated surrogate waveforms that accurately emulate gravitational‑wave signals, allowing for faster and more precise estimation of source parameters. The technique dramatically cuts the computational expense of traditional numerical‑relativity methods while preserving high fidelity.
title: Machine-learning surrogate waveforms boost gravitational‑wave parameter estimation
